people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
translations.bsb: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
translations.kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
translations.asv: And Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
